state.question: On what date did this building officially open, according to the record?
state.answer: According to the building record, the Klaus Advanced Computing Building officially opened on October 26, 2006. The building was a gift from Christopher Klaus, and it supports computing research. The image shows the building entrance with a rainbow staircase and a person sweeping snow. The building’s name is clearly visible above the entrance.
state.supplied_evidence: Building record (paraphrased from https://sites.cc.gatech.edu/compiler/archive/compiler-november06.html): The Klaus Advanced Computing Building officially opened with a ribbon-cutting on October 26, 2006. A gift from Christopher Klaus made it possible. It supports computing research, including robotics, supercomputing and information security.
